customers.evidence: Provide the world’s best customer experience every day.

employees.evidence: We view each other as colleagues – part of the same team, striving to deliver the brand promise to our customers and each other every day.

dei.evidence: We are a diverse and inclusive company, and serve diverse customers.

community.evidence: We aim to make a difference in the communities where we work and live.

shareholders.evidence: Become essential to our customers by providing differentiated products and services to help them achieve their aspirations.

integrity.evidence: We earn that trust by ensuring everything we do is reliable, consistent, and with the highest level of integrity.

innovation.evidence: From our innovative products to our world-class customer service, our customers expect the best

result.analyst_notes: Customer-centric and aspirational, with absolute phrasing such as 'every day' and 'unparalleled'. Mostly first-person plural voice. Customers are addressed first and most often; employees, DEI and integrity appear as value statements. No environment or safety content. The 'Our Values' section drives the framing, and the commitments are stated rather than hedged.
